title: Pomolic Acid from the Dong Botanical Drug Madeng'ai Suppresses TNF-alpha-Induced Inflammatory Response in RA-HFLS by Inhibiting NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway Activation.
authors: Huang, Sisi; Cai, Wei; Wang, Yan; Xing, Xiaoliang; Zhang, Zaiqi
one_liner_zh: 研究植物药活性成分Pomolic Acid通过抑制NF-kappaB信号通路发挥抗炎作用，仅涉及分子对接预测配体与蛋白结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法聚焦于TF-DNA结合机制。
abstract: Objective: This study aimed to investigate whether pomolic acid (PA), a predicted bioactive metabolite of the Dong botanical drug Madeng'ai (MDA), suppresses inflammatory cytokine expression by inhibiting nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB) pathway activation in a tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha)-induced human rheumatoid arthritis fibroblast-like synoviocyte (RA-HFLS) model. Methods: PA content in MDA from different regions and harvest years was quantified via High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC). Network analysis was employed as a hypothesis-generating tool to predict potential targets and pathways, followed by molecular docking to validate the binding affinity of PA to core targets of the NF-kappaB pathway, and ADMET prediction to evaluate its pharmacokinetic properties and safety profile. The RA-HFLS inflammatory model was induced by TNF-alpha. Cell viability and inflammatory cytokine secretion were assessed using Cell Counting Kit-8 (CCK-8) and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). NF-kappaB signaling pathway activation and downstream gene expression were examined by Western blot and reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), respectively. Results: HPLC analysis revealed that MDA samples from Guizhou harvested in 2019 contained the highest PA content (0.1117 mg/g). Network analysis predicted the NF-kappaB signaling pathway as a candidate mechanism underlying PA's potential anti-inflammatory effects. Molecular docking showed that PA stably bound to IKKbeta, p65, and IkappaBalpha, while ADMET prediction indicated favorable intestinal absorption, low drug-drug interaction risk, and good genetic safety, albeit with potential hepatotoxicity and reproductive toxicity risks. In the TNF-alpha-induced RA-HFLS model, PA dose-dependently inhibited abnormal cell proliferation and significantly reduced the secretion of pro-inflammatory cytokines TNF-alpha and interleukin-6 (IL-6). Mechanistic studies indicated that PA suppressed the activation of the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, thereby downregulating the mRNA expression of inflammatory genes such as IL-6, TNF-alpha, and interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta). Conclusions: PA, a bioactive metabolite of the Dong botanical drug MDA, may inhibit NF-kappaB signaling pathway activation, thereby downregulating TNF-alpha-induced inflammatory cytokine expression in RA-HFLS, demonstrating its in vitro anti-inflammatory potential.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在探讨坡模酸（pomolic acid, PA）——侗族药材马登艾（Madeng'ai, MDA）的一种预测生物活性代谢物——是否通过抑制核因子-κB（nuclear factor-kappaB, NF-kappaB）通路激活，在肿瘤坏死因子-α（tumor necrosis factor-alpha, TNF-alpha）诱导的人风湿性关节炎成纤维样滑膜细胞（RA-HFLS）模型中抑制炎症细胞因子表达。方法：采用高效液相色谱法（High-Performance Liquid Chromatography, HPLC）定量分析不同产地和采收年份MDA中PA的含量。网络分析作为假设生成工具，用于预测潜在靶点和通路，随后通过分子对接验证PA与NF-kappaB通路核心靶点的结合亲和力，并进行ADMET预测以评估其药代动力学特性和安全性。RA-HFLS炎症模型由TNF-alpha诱导。细胞活力和炎症细胞因子分泌分别使用细胞计数试剂盒-8（Cell Counting Kit-8, CCK-8）和酶联免疫吸附测定（enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, ELISA）评估。NF-kappaB信号通路激活和下游基因表达分别通过Western blot和逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction, RT-qPCR）检测。结果：HPLC分析显示，2019年采收的贵州MDA样品中PA含量最高（0.1117 mg/g）。网络分析预测NF-kappaB信号通路是PA潜在抗炎效应的候选机制。分子对接显示PA与IKKbeta、p65和IkappaBalpha稳定结合，而ADMET预测表明其具有良好的肠道吸收、低药物相互作用风险和良好的遗传安全性，但存在潜在的肝毒性和生殖毒性风险。在TNF-alpha诱导的RA-HFLS模型中，PA剂量依赖性地抑制异常细胞增殖，并显著降低促炎细胞因子TNF-alpha和白细胞介素-6（interleukin-6, IL-6）的分泌。机制研究表明，PA抑制NF-kappaB信号通路激活，从而下调IL-6、TNF-alpha和白细胞介素-1beta（interleukin-1beta, IL-1beta）等炎症基因的mRNA表达。结论：PA作为侗族药材MDA的生物活性代谢物，可能通过抑制NF-kappaB信号通路激活，下调RA-HFLS中TNF-alpha诱导的炎症细胞因子表达，展示其体外抗炎潜力。
